rows.en: (I'm out with Yuuto today...)

Yuuto, where's this place
you wanted to stop by?
rows.notes: x5. The script also shows this line under Kagura's plate (frd_kgr_008 both branches) and again for the player after the cemetery scene jump, apparently a leftover in the script. Translated as the player's question; it cannot be made to fit Kagura speaking.

rows.en: Arlington Cemetery.
rows.notes: Arlington Cemetery is provisional in locations.json.

rows.en: Do you go there often?
Yeah, my dad's grave is there...
All right, let's go.

My dad was already gone by the time
I was old enough to remember.
My mom raised me all on her own.

Thanks to her, I got into the Pilot Course
and became a pilot.
That's why I want to protect my mom.
I see. Then you'd better give it your all.
Yeah, I will.
I'm rooting for you.
Yeah, thanks.
rows.notes: x6: also Ranka (frd_rnk_008) and the player (frd_nns_002, scd_com_620 Valentine); fits.

rows.en:
All riiight!
Race you over there!!
Wh-what for?!

Hey, what are you doing?!
I'm gonna leave you behind!!
Okay, coming!

(I'll work hard too,
so I don't lose to Yuuto!)
(I'm out with Kagura-kun today...)

Kagura-kun, where's this place
you wanted to stop by?
I see. Then you'd better give it your all.
I'm rooting for you.
Just rooting for me?
Won't you stay by my side?
What's that supposed to mean?
Y-you can take it however you like.

W-well, we're both busy right now!
You can give me an answer whenever!!
H-hey, wait!?
What's with him... Geez...
Mmm, coming~!

(Was Kagura-kun just... covering up
how embarrassed he was...?)
(I was hanging out with Yuuto again today...)
Do you have some time after this?

Sure, but is there somewhere
you want to stop by?
Mind if we go to the cemetery again?
Yeah, sure.
rows.notes: x3: also frd_rnk_115 (Ranka asks to chat); fits.

rows.en: You were praying really hard again today.

It's not really praying.
I'm giving my dad a report.
What were you reporting?

All kinds of things. School, work...
and you.

Me?
Wh-what did you say about me...?
That's a secret.

That's kind of scary. I'm not gonna get
cursed later or anything, right?

As if that would ever happen...
What are you even saying...?
rows.notes: Japanese has no subject for 'do such a thing' (the curse, presumably from his dead father). Kept impersonal ('As if that would ever happen') rather than guessing he/my dad.

rows.en: Just kidding.
Geez...
rows.notes: x7: also Luca, Alto, the player (Gary/Michel scenes); fits all.

rows.en: Yeah, I guess so.
rows.notes: x4: also Alto (nml_alt_015, 'another time then'); fits.

rows.en:
No, it's nothing.
Come on, let's go home!

(I wonder what he's been
reporting about me?)

(I was hanging out with Kagura-kun
again today...)
Okay, sure.
rows.notes: x8: player and Ranka in several scenes (agreeing to go/eat together); fits.

rows.en:
M-me?
Wh-what did you say about me...?
Don't get so mad. I was just joking...
Well then, let's head home.

(I wonder what he's been
reporting about me?)
I heard you made Captain?
Yeah, finally.

(So Yuuto's in the middle of
servicing his fighter...)

\p...
It's all thanks to you.

No, it's the result of
your own hard work, Yuuto.
Y-you think so?
rows.notes: x5: also the player (frd_kgr_105, frd_myk_003); fits.

rows.en: Yeah, I really did work hard, didn't I!!
But I can't stop here!

\p!
I want to walk this path together with you!!
You need more energy than that!
Let's go, then!
That's it! Off to our universe!!

Kagura ending (male).
Slot filler for female.
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (female branch of the male-only ending frd_kgr_009); translated literally, as c06488.
